DecisionLogEntry.title: DecisionLogEntry
DecisionLogEntry.description: Advisory guardrail evaluation entry logged by an authenticated user for a specific market data window.

timestamp.description: Firestore server timestamp recorded at write time.

source.description: Market data source used for the evaluated candles.

timeframe.description: Candle resolution and lookback window label.

firedRules.description: Named guardrail rule identifiers that triggered.

reasons.description: Quantitative reason strings derived from live metric values and thresholds.

inputs.description: Regime metric inputs evaluated (score, volZ, trend, changePointsInWindow, lastChangePointAgeBars).

thresholdsUsed.description: Numeric threshold settings used during evaluation.

lastCandleTime.description: Unix timestamp in seconds of the final loaded candle, or null when empty.

candleCount.description: Number of candles loaded in the evaluated window.

/users/{uid}/decisions/{docId}.description: Per-user advisory guardrail decision log entries owned and accessible solely by request.auth.uid == uid.
